tasks.title: Implement JWT token service (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
Create a token service that issues signed JWTs with configurable
expiry, refresh tokens, and revocation via a deny list. Use
HMAC-SHA256 with a server-generated secret or RSA key pair.

tasks.title: Wire session auth into middleware (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
Replace the TODO stub in auth.go session mode with real JWT
validation. Extract claims, map to roles (Admin, Approver,
Viewer), and populate request context.

tasks.title: Add login and logout API endpoints (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
POST /api/auth/login (credentials → JWT + refresh token),
POST /api/auth/refresh (refresh → new JWT),
POST /api/auth/logout (revoke tokens).
Rate-limit login attempts.

tasks.title: Add session auth test coverage (Session Authentication)
tasks.description:
Unit tests for token service (issue, validate, refresh, revoke).
Integration tests for login flow, expired tokens, role mapping,
and rate limiting. Target 90%+ coverage on auth package.

tasks.title: Add OIDC provider configuration (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Extend DashboardAuthConfig with OIDC fields: issuer URL,
client ID, client secret, redirect URI, scopes, and claim
mappings. Support discovery via .well-known/openid-configuration.

tasks.title: Implement OIDC authorization code flow (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Add /api/auth/oidc/login (redirect to IdP), /api/auth/oidc/callback
(exchange code for tokens, create session). Validate ID tokens,
extract claims, map groups to roles.

tasks.title: Map OIDC claims to Relicta roles (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Configurable claim-to-role mapping (e.g., groups claim "relicta-admins"
→ Admin role). Support multiple IdPs with independent mappings.
Fallback to default Viewer role for unmapped users.

tasks.title: Test OIDC flows and document setup (OIDC / SSO Integration)
tasks.description:
Integration tests with a mock OIDC provider. Document IdP setup
for Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace with example configs.

tasks.title: Define persistence port interface (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Extract a clean port interface from the file event store adapter.
Both file-based and PostgreSQL adapters implement the same interface.
Use the repository pattern from the existing hexagonal architecture.

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL adapter (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Implement the persistence port using sqlc for type-safe query
generation with pgx as the driver. Store events in an append-only
events table with JSONB payload. Add indexes for release ID,
timestamp, and event type. Use connection pooling.

tasks.title: Add database migration framework (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Embed SQL migrations via go:embed. Support up/down migrations
with version tracking. Add `relicta db migrate` and
`relicta db status` CLI commands. Use golang-migrate or similar.

tasks.title: Add persistence configuration (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Extend config schema with persistence section: backend type
(file, postgres), connection string (with env var expansion),
pool size, migration mode (auto, manual). Wire adapter selection
in container setup.

tasks.title: Add persistence layer tests (Database Persistence Layer)
tasks.description:
Unit tests with interface mocks. Integration tests with testcontainers
for PostgreSQL. Test migration up/down, concurrent writes, event
replay, and failover to file-based when DB is unreachable.

tasks.title: Capture analytics events (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
Emit structured analytics events for: risk evaluations, policy
decisions, approval outcomes, release durations, bump types.
Store via the persistence port (file or PostgreSQL).

tasks.title: Add analytics query endpoints (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
GET /api/analytics/risk-trends (time-series risk scores),
GET /api/analytics/decisions (policy decision distribution),
GET /api/analytics/team (approvals per actor, release velocity).
Support date range and granularity parameters.

tasks.title: Implement analytics aggregation (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
Pre-aggregate metrics for dashboard performance: daily/weekly/monthly
rollups for risk scores, decision counts, release frequency.
For file backend, aggregate on read. For PostgreSQL, use
materialized views or scheduled aggregation.

tasks.title: Add analytics test coverage (Analytics Persistence)
tasks.description:
Unit tests for event capture and aggregation logic. Integration
tests for query endpoints with seeded data. Verify both file
and PostgreSQL backends produce consistent results.

tasks.title: Add API versioning (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Prefix all API routes with /api/v1/. Add version negotiation
via Accept header. Document versioning policy (additive changes
in minor, breaking changes in major).

tasks.title: Add pagination and filtering to list endpoints (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Cursor-based pagination for releases, events, and audit trail
endpoints. Support limit, cursor, sort, and filter query params.
Return Link headers and pagination metadata in response body.

tasks.title: Generate OpenAPI specification (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Annotate handlers with OpenAPI metadata. Generate spec at build
time or serve at /api/v1/openapi.json. Include authentication
schemes, error responses, and example payloads.

tasks.title: Implement structured error responses (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Standardize error format: {code, message, details, request_id}.
Map domain errors to HTTP status codes consistently. Add
request ID middleware for correlation.

tasks.title: Add API contract tests (REST API Hardening)
tasks.description:
Integration tests verifying pagination, error formats, versioning,
and OpenAPI spec accuracy. Use golden file tests for response
shapes. Target full endpoint coverage.

tasks.title: Add persistent webhook delivery queue (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Queue webhook deliveries for async processing. Persist pending
deliveries so they survive restarts. Process in order per
endpoint with configurable concurrency.

tasks.title: Implement retry with exponential backoff (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Retry failed deliveries with exponential backoff and jitter.
Respect Retry-After headers. Move to dead-letter after max
retries. Log all delivery attempts with status codes.

tasks.title: Add webhook delivery log (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Log delivery attempts with timestamp, endpoint, status code,
response time, and payload hash. Expose via
GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries. Support manual re-delivery.

tasks.title: Add webhook delivery tests (Webhook Delivery Hardening)
tasks.description:
Unit tests for queue, retry logic, and backoff calculation.
Integration tests with httptest server simulating failures,
slow responses, and redirects.

tasks.title: Implement Monorepo Workspace Orchestration
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Monorepo Workspace Orchestration. Add first-class monorepo support for governing changes across multiple packages in a single repository. Detect workspace structure (Go modules, npm workspaces, Cargo workspaces), analyze per-package changes independently, support independent versioning per package, and coordinate cross-package releases. This addresses the PRD's "Monorepo support gaps" risk (rated High) and is critical for enterprise adoption where monorepos are standard.

tasks.title: Implement CGP Protocol Wire Format
tasks.description: Implement the feature: CGP Protocol Wire Format. Formalize the Change Governance Protocol (CGP) wire format as described in PRD Section 17. Implement CGP message types (change.proposal, change.decision, change.execution_authorized) as structured JSON with versioning. Add CGP endpoints to the MCP server so AI agents can propose changes via the protocol. Create a CGP SDK package that other tools can import to become CGP-compliant. This positions Relicta as the reference implementation of an open governance standard.

tasks.title: Implement Audience-Aware Release Communication
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Audience-Aware Release Communication. Implement the stakeholder communication layer from PRD Section 11. Generate audience-specific release narratives (engineering, product, executive, external) derived from approved governance decisions. Support bundling changes across components into coherent narratives. Add communication templates with configurable tone and detail level. Integrate with existing AI providers for narrative generation. This moves Relicta from "output" (changelogs) to "outcomes" (stakeholder communication).

tasks.title: Implement Release Memory and Learning
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Release Memory and Learning. Build the historical context system from PRD Section 16.4. Track past incidents, rollbacks, and their root causes. Identify patterns of risky changes across releases. Feed historical outcomes back into risk scoring so future evaluations improve over time. Store release memory in the persistence layer (file or PostgreSQL). Surface insights via the dashboard analytics. This enables Relicta to continuously improve beyond what stateless tools can achieve.

tasks.title: Implement Dashboard Frontend Separation
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Dashboard Frontend Separation. Extract the embedded Vue dashboard into a standalone deployable frontend as described in PRD Section 14.1. Support CDN-friendly deployment (Vercel, CloudFront, S3). Add real-time updates via WebSocket for release progress, approval notifications, and analytics. Build dashboard views for the new analytics data (risk trends, decision distribution, team metrics). The Go backend serves as a standalone API service alongside the CLI.

tasks.title: Implement Pre-release and Release Channel Support
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Pre-release and Release Channel Support. Add pre-release versioning (alpha, beta, rc) and release channels (stable, canary, next). Support promoting pre-releases through channels with governance gates at each stage. Track channel-specific policies (e.g., canary requires lower approval threshold than stable). This addresses the PRD's "Missing critical workflows (pre-release)" gap identified in the product strategy review.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Repository Governance
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Multi-Repository Governance. Coordinate release governance across multiple separate repositories that form a product or platform. Define repository groups with dependency relationships, synchronize version constraints across repos, enforce cross-repo release policies (e.g., "service-api must release before service-client"), and provide a unified view of multi-repo release state. Support both centralized governance (one Relicta instance governs all repos) and federated governance (each repo has Relicta, coordinated via CGP messages). Integrate with the existing CGP protocol for cross-repo proposal/decision exchange.

tasks.title: Implement Runtime Observability Integration
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Runtime Observability Integration. Connect post-deployment outcomes back to the release memory system for continuous learning. Integrate with observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry) to automatically detect incidents, error rate spikes, and rollbacks that correlate with specific releases. Auto-record outcomes in the release memory when deployment metrics cross configured thresholds. Surface deployment health in the dashboard with release-correlated metrics. This closes the feedback loop so Relicta's risk scoring improves with real production data rather than relying solely on code analysis.

tasks.title: Implement EU AI Act Article 12 Evidence Pack
tasks.description: Implement the feature: EU AI Act Article 12 Evidence Pack. Extend `relicta report --type` to emit `eu-ai-act-article-12` log bundle from existing CGP audit chain. Maps governance events to Article 12 logging requirements: start/end timestamps per use, reference databases, input data leading to match, identification of natural persons verifying results. Output formats: JSON Lines (machine), Markdown summary (auditor), CSV (regulator). Retention metadata: 6-month minimum log retention enforced via persistence layer config. Files to extend: `internal/cli/report.go`, `internal/compliance/report.go`, `internal/compliance/article12.go` (new). Source: hash-chained audit at `internal/cgp/audit/`. Forcing function: August 2026 EU AI Act high-risk provisions.

tasks.title: Implement EU AI Act Annex IV Technical Documentation Generator
tasks.description: Implement the feature: EU AI Act Annex IV Technical Documentation Generator. New `relicta report --type ai-act-annex-iv` produces section-by-section Annex IV technical documentation from CGP risk + audit + memory data. Sections: general description, detailed description of system elements, monitoring/functioning/control, risk management system (maps to risk calculator output), data and data governance (maps to actor attribution), accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity (maps to attestation chain), human oversight (maps to approval records). Output: Markdown + PDF. 10-year retention metadata. This is the differentiator Microsoft AGT does not generate. Files: `internal/compliance/annex_iv.go` (new), templates in `internal/compliance/templates/annex_iv/`. Required for €60-80K fintech/healthtech buyer in EU.

tasks.title: Implement Agent Autonomy Profiles (per-actor governance budgets)
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Agent Autonomy Profiles (per-actor governance budgets). Extend `internal/cgp/policy/` with `actor_budget.go` defining per-actor budgets: max_blast_radius, max_risk_score, max_dollar_cost_usd, requires_cosign list, allowed_tools/denied_tools whitelist, time-window limits. Schema in `.relicta/actor-budgets.yaml` keyed on actor_type + actor_id glob. Enforcement at `internal/mcp/server.go` tool dispatch — pre-flight checks resolve actor from MCP session metadata, reject with structured error if violated. Extend `ActorType` enum at `internal/domain/release/domain/run.go:49` with ActorID string. Audit chain records every budget check. Default profile: refuse `--yes` on agent-actor + risk>=0.4 + no policy file. Killer differentiator over GitHub Required Reviewers (no actor-typed concept) and Microsoft AGT (runtime, not release).

tasks.title: Implement Security Gate Hardening
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Security Gate Hardening. Remove `|| true` from `Makefile:520-525` security-scan target. Run `nox baseline_add` against current 280 findings (1 critical, 170 high, 100 medium, 11 low) — triage and either fix or baseline with justification. SEC-435 (.env.example, docs) likely false positive — baseline with rationale. SEC-436/437 in `internal/errors/errors.go:475-477` need real review (error message disclosure?). AI-007 already baselined. Add `make security-scan-strict` to `check-ci` as failing target. CI gate: zero NEW high+ findings on PR. Non-negotiable for any regulated-buyer demo.

tasks.title: Implement CLAUDE.md Reality Sync
tasks.description: Implement the feature: CLAUDE.md Reality Sync. Fix architecture documentation drift in both repos. CLI: `relicta/CLAUDE.md` claims `internal/state/` (does not exist), claims `internal/service/{git,version,ai,template}` (actually under `internal/infrastructure/`). Update to reflect 23 real internal dirs: analysis, analytics, application, benchmark, cgp, cli, compliance, config, container, domain, errors, fileutil, httpserver, infrastructure, mcp, observability, plugin, security, service, ui, version. Hub: `relicta-hub/CLAUDE.md` claims stdlib `net/http` routing (uses Gin), claims "Hub imports domain logic from CLI" (zero CLI imports verified). Replace with honest description of skeleton state + alpha banner. Trust leak in enterprise security review until fixed.

tasks.title: Implement Vanta API Integration (Evidence Push)
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Vanta API Integration (Evidence Push). Push Relicta attestation events to Vanta as evidence artifacts via Vanta REST API. New plugin `plugins/vanta/` (Go, gRPC plugin pattern matching existing plugin architecture). Triggered on PostPublish hook. Maps Relicta events to Vanta evidence types: governance decisions → custom evidence, audit chain entries → control evidence, actor attestations → access reviews. Configurable framework mapping (SOC2 CC6.1/CC7.1/CC7.4 already in `enterprise-soc2` template). Vanta released MCP server April 15 2026 — explicit partnership angle, not competitive. Sarah persona: "Vanta partnership = non-negotiable." Files: `plugins/vanta/main.go`, `plugins/vanta/client.go`, `plugins/vanta/mapping.go`. Drata follows same pattern as P1.

tasks.title: Implement Plugin Registry Cull
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Plugin Registry Cull. `plugins/registry.yaml` lists 39 named plugins (github, gitlab, slack, jira, npm, homebrew, docker, etc.) but `plugins/` has zero `.go` files — each entry references separate repo. Most likely don't exist. Security review red flag: every empty plugin = credibility leak. Cull registry to 5-7 plugins actually owned, tested, and shipped (recommended: github, gitlab, slack, jira, npm). Remove other 32+ entries. Add `make plugin-verify` target validating each registry entry resolves to working binary at advertised checksum. Alternative: keep registry but mark unverified entries as `status: community` with disclaimer. Position decision: "registry of vapor" vs "small registry of real" — pick small/real.

tasks.title: Implement Reposition README and Tagline
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Reposition README and Tagline. Rewrite README hero from "The governance layer for software change" (vague, overlaps Vanta+MS AGT) to "Cryptographically-attested release governance for AI-native engineering. EU AI Act Annex IV ready." Differentiator stack: (1) hash-chained audit chain (CGP) 99.1% test coverage, (2) actor-typed governance Human/CI/Agent, (3) Article 12 + Annex IV from existing audit data (Microsoft AGT does not), (4) pushes evidence to Vanta/Drata (partner not replace). Add comparison matrix vs Vanta (different surface: ex-ante decision attestation vs ex-post posture scan), Microsoft AGT (release-time vs runtime), GitHub Required Reviewers (gate vs prove). Update brand assets reference. Files: `README.md`, `docs/positioning.md` (new).

tasks.title: Implement AI 2026 Model Migration
tasks.description: Implement the feature: AI 2026 Model Migration. Bump default models from 2024-vintage to 2026 across providers. Anthropic at `anthropic.go:27`: `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` → `claude-sonnet-4-6` default, `claude-opus-4-7` for high-stakes release narratives, `claude-haiku-4-5` for diff summaries. OpenAI at `service.go:138`: `gpt-4` → `gpt-5` default, `gpt-5-mini` for narrative. Gemini at `gemini.go:26`: `gemini-2.0-flash-exp` → `gemini-2.5-flash`. Add per-use-case override config: `ai.model_overrides.{release_notes, risk_narrative, communicate, summarize_diff}`. Add `WithModel(string)` option in `service.go`. Update `docs/ai-providers.md` table (currently cites GPT-4o/3.5, Claude 3.5 Sonnet/3 Opus, Gemini 2.0 Flash/1.5 Pro — all pre-2026). Risk: prompts tuned for old models may regress — gate bump on eval harness V0.

tasks.title: Implement Anthropic Prompt Caching
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Anthropic Prompt Caching. Implement `cache_control: ephemeral` blocks on Anthropic API calls. Currently zero `cache_control` hits in `internal/` and `pkg/`. Prime targets: long stable system prompts in `internal/infrastructure/ai/prompts.go` (281 LOC), repo context blocks (commit list, file globs, codebase summary) re-tokenized every release. Expected impact: 5-10x cost reduction on repeated governance evaluations + release-notes path. Cache key strategy: hash repo context block, invalidate on detected schema change. Files to extend: `internal/infrastructure/ai/anthropic.go`, `internal/infrastructure/ai/prompts.go`. Cost discipline = enterprise procurement requirement.

tasks.title: Implement Structured Outputs and JSON Schema Mode
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Structured Outputs and JSON Schema Mode. Replace regex-parsing of LLM output with provider-native structured outputs. Currently zero `response_format`/`ResponseFormat` hits across codebase. OpenAI: `response_format: json_schema` with strict mode for `GovernanceDecision`, `RiskNarrative`, `ReleaseNotes`, `AudienceNarrative` types. Anthropic: tool-use with structured output schema. Define schemas in `internal/infrastructure/ai/schemas/`. Eliminates parse failures and "model returned malformed JSON" runtime errors that LLM-as-content-generator-for-governance cannot tolerate. Files: `openai.go`, `anthropic.go`, `gemini.go`, new `schemas/` dir. Reliability requirement for governance product.

tasks.title: Implement AI Eval Harness V0
tasks.description: Implement the feature: AI Eval Harness V0. Build LLM evaluation harness — currently absent. New `internal/infrastructure/ai/evals/`. 150 golden YAML examples across categories: release-notes (60), risk-narrative (40), communicate-cmd (30), diff-summary (20). Each: input, context, rubric (factuality, governance-alignment, terseness, no-hallucination, structured-output-valid), optional reference. Judge model: `claude-opus-4-7` LLM-as-judge with structured output (1-5 per criterion + rationale). Cross-check 10% with `gpt-5` for judge bias. CI gate `make ai-eval`: fail if mean < 4.0 or factuality < 3 or structured-output-valid < 5. Run on AI-touching PRs only via path filter. Cost ~$2/full run. Files: `evals/runner.go`, `evals/judge.go`, `evals/golden/*.yaml`, `.github/workflows/ai-eval.yml`. **Blocks model bump merges.** Non-negotiable for governance-grade AI prose.

tasks.title: Implement Postgres Adapter Test Coverage 0% to 70%
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Postgres Adapter Test Coverage 0% to 70%. `internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres/` ships at 0.0% test coverage. `store.go` 294, `migrator.go` 308, `pool.go` 32 — all untested. README claims "PostgreSQL persistence" — claim becomes true at 70%+ coverage. Add `testcontainers-go` integration suite. Test scenarios: connection pool lifecycle, migration up/down idempotency, concurrent writes (event store), failover to file-based when DB unreachable, transaction isolation, JSONB query correctness. Add migrations 002-005 covering aggregates beyond events (releases, approvals, audit_chain projections, attestations). Single events table with JSONB without projections is event-store-as-database antipattern. Block release until coverage gate.

tasks.title: Implement Reverse MCP Resources (governance-as-context)
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Reverse MCP Resources (governance-as-context). MCP server at `internal/mcp/server.go` (2362 LOC) exposes governance tools to AI agents. Add MCP resources (readable context, complement to tools) so coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin) plan WITH governance context — shift-left from post-facto governance. Resources to expose: `relicta://policy/current` (active CGP policy as JSON), `relicta://risk-budget/{actor_id}` (remaining budget), `relicta://recent-incidents?days=30` (postmortem feed), `relicta://blast-radius/{service}` (dependency/impact graph), `relicta://release-history/{service}?limit=10` (prior runs + outcomes), `relicta://compliance-frameworks` (active frameworks). Verify first whether `resources/list` handler exists in `server.go`; if absent, add. Turns Relicta into context provider for any MCP-aware coding agent. Differentiation moat against Vanta MCP (different scope: compliance posture vs governance context).

tasks.title: Implement Drata API Integration (Evidence Push)
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Drata API Integration (Evidence Push). Mirror Vanta integration for Drata. New plugin `plugins/drata/`. Drata API focused on extracting compliance data and programmatically uploading evidence types. Push Relicta attestations as evidence artifacts. Drata 170+ integrations covers AWS/GitHub/Okta/Workspace — Relicta becomes upstream provenance source for AI-attributed releases that Drata cannot generate from CI/Git data alone. Same gRPC plugin architecture as Vanta plugin. Files: `plugins/drata/main.go`, `plugins/drata/client.go`, `plugins/drata/mapping.go`. Sequencing: ship after Vanta validates pattern.

tasks.title: Implement Cobra Command Groups
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Cobra Command Groups. 30+ flat top-level commands violate Hick's + Miller's 7±2. `relicta --help` is wall of unstructured commands. Use `cobra.Group` (Cobra 1.6+) to organize. Group IDs: `lifecycle` (init/plan/bump/notes/approve/publish/release/promote/rollback/cancel), `inspect` (status/blast/history/evaluate/report), `multi` (group/* multirepo), `extend` (plugin*/mcp/serve/server), `ops` (db/health/metrics/clean/verify). Set `cmd.GroupID` on every `AddCommand` in `internal/cli/root.go`. Zero behavior change, ~40 LOC. XS effort, high UX leverage.

tasks.title: Implement Approval Card Shared Schema
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Approval Card Shared Schema. Three approval surfaces drift: TUI (`internal/cli/approve.go:469-510` tabwriter plain text), web (`web/src/views/ApprovalWorkflow.vue`), MCP server tool dispatch. Risk score formatted three ways. Define `ApprovalCardSchema` JSON contract in `internal/governance/` (or `pkg/cgp/approval_card.go`). Generate Vue prop types via `openapi-typescript` from the schema. Mirror lipgloss render in TUI from same struct. Single source of truth for: risk score, factors list, diff summary, actor, required actions ordering, rationale display. Jakob's Law banked across surfaces. Files: schema definition, TUI renderer extraction, Vue component refactor.

tasks.title: Implement Risk Display lipgloss Visualization
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Risk Display lipgloss Visualization. `internal/cli/approve.go:455-511` displays risk as plain `Risk Score: 47.0% (MEDIUM)` text alongside other fields in tabwriter. Highest-leverage decision input given lowest visual weight. Charmbracelet lipgloss already imported. Render risk: bordered lipgloss block, `lipgloss.Color("196"/"214"/"34")` for HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, horizontal `progress.Model` bar, top-3 risk factors above release metadata. APCA-compliant pairs with `▲▲▲` glyph for color-blind / `NO_COLOR` env. Same struct exposed via Approval Card Schema for web consumption (see related feature). Files: `internal/cli/approve.go`, new `internal/ui/risk.go` for reusable component.

tasks.title: Implement Init Quick Mode
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Init Quick Mode. Current `relicta init` 8-step wizard violates Goal-Gradient + Doherty Threshold. New `relicta init --quick` infers from git remote + `package.json`/`go.mod`/`Cargo.toml` → 1-confirm screen with detected defaults. Existing wizard becomes `relicta init --guided`. Show progress `[3/8]` via `progress.Model`. Collapse advanced (channels, OIDC, plugins) behind `--advanced` flag. Init wizard should also write a starter governance policy file by default (sensible: require approval for major, auto-approve patch <0.3 risk, block on security factors) — first governed release achievable without policy authoring. Files: `internal/cli/init.go`, `internal/config/templates/`.

tasks.title: Implement policy.go God File Split
tasks.description: Implement the feature: policy.go God File Split. `internal/cli/policy.go` is 2318 LOC with 57 functions mixing validate/list/scaffold/test/matrix/explain. Highest contributor-friction file in repo. Split by verb into 6 files: `policy_validate.go`, `policy_list.go`, `policy_scaffold.go`, `policy_test.go`, `policy_matrix.go`, `policy_explain.go`. Each delegates to existing `internal/application/policy/` (already exists, underused). Same pattern for `internal/mcp/server.go` (2362 LOC) — split by tool category. Domain layer is clean — don't touch what works. PR review time drops from hours to minutes. Unblocks parallel feature work. Plan/approve/release CLI files (under 1100 LOC each) tolerable for now — defer.

tasks.title: Implement Architecture Fitness Functions
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Architecture Fitness Functions. Zero fitness/architecture tests. `find . -name 'arch_test.go'` empty. Add two as priority. **FF#1 Hexagonal boundary** at `internal/architecture/layering_test.go`: assert packages under `internal/cli/` MUST NOT import `internal/infrastructure/*` except via `internal/application/*`. Tool: `go list -deps -json ./internal/cli/...` filtered. Catches policy.go-style rot at PR time. **FF#2 CGP protocol stability** at `pkg/cgp/compat_test.go`: assert golden JSON envelopes from `testdata/v0.1/*.json` MUST round-trip through current Marshal/Unmarshal byte-identical. `//go:embed testdata`, deep-equal. Protects external CGP consumers from silent breakage — critical because CGP positioned as protocol with public SDK.

tasks.title: Implement Web Dashboard Accessibility CI Gate
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Web Dashboard Accessibility CI Gate. Web dashboard at `relicta/web/` has 11 Vue views shipped, a11y unverified. Tailwind defaults rarely hit AAA contrast on risk colors (red/amber/green = APCA failure pattern). Risk pages = highest stakes. Compliance/Security Officer persona uses screen readers in regulated industries — literal target buyer. Add `@axe-core/playwright` to existing test setup. CI gate: zero violations on `ApprovalWorkflow.vue`, `ReleaseDetail.vue`, `GovernanceAnalytics.vue`. Replace red/green-only state encoding with APCA-compliant pair + redundant icon (shape+color). Add `aria-live="polite"` on approval state changes. Files: `web/playwright.config.ts`, `web/tests/a11y/*.spec.ts`, audit pass on Vue components.

tasks.title: Implement Plugin Sandbox Honesty
tasks.description: Implement the feature: Plugin Sandbox Honesty. `internal/plugin/sandbox/sandbox_darwin.go:14-28` self-documents that RLIMIT_AS unenforced on Apple Silicon, no `sandbox-exec` profile, CPU limits absent. README markets sandboxing as security boundary. Two paths: (a) ship `sandbox-exec` profile generation on darwin + seccomp-bpf on linux + plugin signature verification (currently missing entirely from `manager.go`), or (b) downgrade marketing — rename to `ResourceAdvisor`, surface "best-effort" loudly at config-load time, require explicit `--allow-untrusted-plugins` flag for non-signed plugins. Pick (a) for enterprise credibility OR (b) for honest minimal viable. Either way: honesty before next major release.
